result.instructions: Tools for ASPSMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many ASPSMS credits are left on my account?"; "Send 'Your order has shipped' from MYSHOP to +41791234567."; "Show the delivery status of the SMS sent with reference order-1042.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ASPSMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run aspsms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run aspsms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run aspsms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. aspsms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: aspsms_check_credits
tools.title: Check credits
tools.description: Show the remaining ASPSMS credit balance of the account. Read-only. Calls the ASPSMS CheckCredits method.

tools.name: aspsms_inquire_delivery_notifications
tools.title: Inquire delivery notifications
tools.description: Read the delivery status of SMS messages sent with a transaction reference (set when the SMS was sent). Read-only. Calls InquireDeliveryNotifications.

transactionReferenceNumbers.description: Transaction reference numbers to look up, as sent with the SMS (max 100).

tools.name: aspsms_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: Send one or more real SMS messages and spend the account's ASPSMS credits. Sends cannot be recalled. Confirm the recipients and the text with the user before calling. Calls SendTextSMS.

originator.description: Sender: up to 11 letters or digits (e.g. MYBUSINESS), or a phone number in E.164 form that is unlocked (see aspsms_unlock_originator).

recipients.description: Recipient numbers, for example +41791234567. Add an optional reference after a colon, e.g. +41791234567:order-1042 (max 1000).

messageText.description: Message text. Unicode text is limited to 603 characters, plain ASCII text to 1377 characters.

forceGsm7bit.description: Send GSM 7-bit characters only, to avoid Unicode cost.

deferredDeliveryTime.description: Optional send time in ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+01:00.

tools.name: aspsms_unlock_originator
tools.title: Unlock originator
tools.description: Unlock a phone number as the sender, using the unlock code that ASPSMS sent to that number. Changes the account's sender settings. Calls UnlockOriginator.

originator.description: The phone number to unlock as sender, in E.164 form.

unlockCode.description: The unlock code received on that phone number.
